evals.name: review-explicit-path
evals.prompt: Review the plan at docs/plans/implementation-plan.md before I start coding. Flag scope creep, missing sections, implicit assumptions, and any failure modes the plan does not account for.
evals.expected_output: Interactive review walking Scope Challenge through Required Sections, findings in [P0|P1|P2] (confidence: N/10) format, a written artifact under .claude/artifacts/eng-reviews/plan-review-*.md, and a Completion Summary at the end.

evals.name: autodetect-latest-plan
evals.prompt: I'm about to start coding. Review my most recent plan doc and tell me what's missing before I write a line of code.
evals.expected_output: Skill auto-detects docs/plans/*.md (should pick tdd-execution-plan.md — newest — OR ask which one if it picks anything else), reads it, produces interactive review with confidence-calibrated findings and an artifact.
